arm1.reference_note: vs_scale_* is the PRIMARY wind test (nested: same model, wind term dropped); vs_base_* also shown

base_v2.desc: frozen v2 plugin through the race DP (reference)

scale_only.desc: free overall scale on the v2 eta — the no-wind calibration control

a_skill_x_wind.desc: (a) skill x wind: eta -> s*eta*(1 + b*(wind-8)/10), outdoor only

b_wind_main.desc: (b) wind main effect on eta magnitude: eta -> s*eta + b*sign(eta)*(wind-8)/10

e_prob_temper.desc: (e) probability temperature: logit(p) -> logit(p)*(1 + b*(wind-8)/10), flattens toward 0.5

f_heat_x_skill.desc: (f bonus) heat version of (a): s*eta*(1 + b*(T-75)/10)

power_arm1.note: d is the fractional change in the per-point skill edge per +10 mph of match-hour wind, outdoor games only

_prespecification: A wind challenger counts as an improvement iff (i) holdout Brier is lower than the identically-fitted no-wind control (scale_only) and (ii) the paired bootstrap on the Brier difference gives P(better) >= 0.95 (the rule spec_shootout.md used to reject ~35 challengers and to flag the one ensemble). Primary inference clusters over EVENTS. Secondary: log-loss must agree in sign and winner accuracy must not fall. Pre-registered partial signal: a challenger that fails overall but wins inside outdoor wind >= 14 mph at P >= 0.95.
